route: A (custom vLLM KV connector, external disk KV)

hardware.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition

experiment.description: Two requests share the same materialized prefix and differ only in the final question; prefix caching disabled so the connector is the only external KV path.

requests.result: store 1,488 KV tokens per layer to disk
external cache hit; inject 1,488 KV tokens

caveats: Prototype connector adapted from vLLM SharedStorageConnector; fixed prefix length configured explicitly.
0.5B model and synthetic materialized prefix; not a production workload.
KV is stored as safetensors on local disk, not in a Memex memory pool; block-level eviction/compression not yet implemented.
Single request pair; no concurrency/preemption tests.
